---
labels: ['OxlintLinter', 'Oxlint', 'module']
description: 'Run modern Oxlint as a Bit development and build linter.'
---

`OxlintLinter` adapts the ESM `oxlint-node` wrapper to Bit's linter service. It
runs one JSON-formatted Oxlint process for a set of components, maps every
diagnostic back to its component and source line, and supports safe fixes through
`bit lint --fix`.

```ts
import {
  OxlintConfigWriter,
  OxlintLinter,
  OxlintTask,
} from '@teambit/oxc.linter.oxlint-linter';

const oxlintOptions = {
  oxlintNodeOptions: {
    configPath: '/absolute/path/to/.oxlintrc.json',
    typeAware: true,
  },
};

const linter = OxlintLinter.from(oxlintOptions);
const buildTask = OxlintTask.from(oxlintOptions);
const configWriter = OxlintConfigWriter.from({
  configPath: '/absolute/path/to/.oxlintrc.json',
});
```

Use `--fix-type suggestions` or `--fix-type dangerously` only when those broader
Oxlint fix modes are intended. The default `bit lint --fix` applies safe fixes.

The config writer copies the complete Oxlint config into each generated root
config. Oxlint's `extends` only inherits rules, plugins, and overrides, so a plain
extending config would silently lose root-only settings such as
`options.typeAware`, `options.typeCheck`, and `settings`.

See the [Oxlint Env example](https://bit.cloud/teambit/oxc/examples/envs/oxlint-env)
for a complete environment integration and the
[Oxlint Node wrapper](https://bit.cloud/teambit/oxc/linter/oxlint-node) for the
lower-level API.
